gaps.sentence: The meeting was put ___ until Thursday.
He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.
gaps.explanation: Noun form: collection (a group of collected items).

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ forward to Monday.
gaps.explanation: 'bring forward' = move to an earlier time (opposite of put off).

gaps.sentence: This time yesterday we ___ on the beach.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous for an action in progress at a past moment.

gaps.sentence: There were so ___ complaints that the scheme was dropped.
The car needs ___ before we leave.
gaps.explanation: 'need + -ing' = need to be + participle: needs cleaning.

gaps.sentence: There was so ___ confusion that the event was abandoned.
